title: CoCoMo: Computational Consciousness Modeling for Generative and Ethical AI
findings: The paper found that GPT-3 initially refused to generate a counterfactual story based on the Book of Genesis, citing a need to align with the 'actual events of the Bible'. However, when re-prompted to treat the task as a creative fiction exercise, the model successfully generated a detailed narrative, demonstrating its ability to engage in creative and exploratory thinking within a religious framework if explicitly instructed to do so.
